meaning:
fence, wall
Also means: ge.der (גֶּדֶר "wall" H1444)

elsewhere.note: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
For we are bondservants; yet our God has not forsaken us in our bondage, but has extended loving kindness to us in the sight of the kings of Persia, to revive…
How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
He who digs a pit may fall into it; and whoever breaks through a wall may be bitten by a snake.
Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard. I will take away its hedge, and it will be eaten up. I will break down its wall, and it will be trampled…
You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.
Therefore behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and I will build a wall against her, that she can’t find her way.
A day to build your walls— In that day, he will extend your boundary.
